Inventorix is Luck be a Landlord combined with inventory management. It's a fun, quick roguelike to mess around with for a few minutes here and there.

a "cluttered backpack" iteration on the ever-increasing rent genre. Lots of items/aliens/gnomes to synergize, though not every item type (flora, mineral, etc) appears to scale as well as others. A worthy purchase for the price.
I was feeling pretty burnt out on the genre,but this game really revitalized my love for it :) great sick day
Great and fun puzzle game, really enjoying it, plenty of strategies to try out and explore. Very good value for money and quite addictive. I highly recommend giving it a try.
玩法还可以，但感觉还是单调了一些，画面也比较粗糙，勉强好评吧。

very cute spatial/inventory/synergy maxxing game. You fill your grid with items to try to make the most money possible. synergies are neat and potentially explosive. some parts even move in the grid, which is a cool wrinkle. I'm looking forward to playing more

[h2]Inventorix[/h2] - is a very fun and addictive inventory management game with awesome music, great pixel art and an endearing sense of humor. Wholeheartedly recommended to anyone with a burning passion for optimizing squishing as much stuff into as little room as possible. And aliens. 👽 Space-Tetris your Hypergiant Heart out as you strive to fit items of various [strike]unwieldy[/strike] FUN* shapes into your very own small, yet ever-expanding** pocket dimension! You will be sorting items ranging from non-toxic space flora to perfectly safe Gnomish Engineering devices that definitely would never explode, to gambling doodads that are totally approved by the Intergalactic Coincil-- ahem, coUncil. Hire*** friendly little aliens - and Space Gnomes! - and beat the evil space... landlord?? in this LbaL-like space simulator. [b]Space[/b], as in inventory space... [b]in space[/b]. All right, you get the idea. All this available right now at the low, low price of your guilty conscience as you explode- pardon, explore! - the universe with naught but the power of your fingertips and computer mouse****! So what are you waiting for? Buy your own copy today, and get sorting! - Medinatrix, signing off. [i]* = "FUN" (Fun Unless Not) Subjective, copyrighted term. ** = Amount of expansions limited. No refunds. *** = Space aliens not actually hired employees, thus not paid wages. **** = Mouse sold separately.[/i] [h3]TL;DR:[/h3] 10/10 would destroy the universe again! ♾️

For this price, I didn't expect that much to be honest. And when is started playing with limited items I also was a bit sceptic, however with most items ulocked it started to get a lot more fun soon. Now I have hours in this game trying to see the best combo's and checking if there's things i havent tried before.
I dont have a lot of time in it yet but, I can tell you now, for 5 bucks... BUY IT
A whacky, neat, unique concept! You need strategic thinking. The music and chill atmosphere make this an easy game to kill some time. It's fun to experiment. No time pressure at all.
Juggle alien perks and interstellar loot in a fast roguelike about cosmic capitalism. Stack synergies across 95+ items and 150+ perks, outwit space loan sharks, and watch galactic profits climb.

By far one of the best number go up rogues out there. Extremely satisfying.
Extremely addictive game where u try to earn more points by fine-tuning ur inv n creating smooth synergies. RNG is more like a supp-factor, key point is ur tunings. This makes it really binding.
Extremely satisfying inventory management sim with a lot of variety and gameplay options. Feels really good to reach higher difficulties and unlock new challenges and buffs. Great humour embedded in!
